messages:
Elena K.: Hey folks — I'm opening a small docs PR this afternoon to add a kv-prefetch matrix for the Optimize toolkit. Goal: concrete guidance for batching vs prefetch vs quant profiles across short/long sequences. Draft snippet below, need 1x Go SDK and 1x Python SDK reviewer + someone to run the docs link-checker when merged.

Rajeev: thanks! can you confirm the intended doc path? under /optimize/toolkit/examples or /optimize/migration/?

Elena K.: planning /optimize/toolkit/matrices/kv-prefetch-matrix.md so it's discoverable from the batching/cache guide. also will add a short migration note for qprofile renames.

Maya: please include a small eval perf table for 16/64/256 token inputs — PMs want numbers to cite. even +/- 10% is helpful.

Tom: if you want me to smoke the snippet locally, paste the e2e command here. I'll run against staging infra (dedicated).

Elena K.: snippet I'm dropping in the PR (python and go). Python first:
```python
# prefetch example (python SDK)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD")
resp = client.optimize.prefetch(
    model="open-llama-8b-quant",
    prefetch_keys=["user_ctx"],
    batch_size=8,
    quant_profile="qprofile-shortseq-v2",
)
print(resp.summary())
```

Elena K.: Go snippet:
```go
// go kv-prefetch sample
c := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
opts := redwood.PrefetchOptions{
  Model: "open-llama-8b-quant",
  PrefetchKeys: []string{"user_ctx"},
  BatchSize: 8,
  QuantProfile: "qprofile-shortseq-v2",
}
res, err := c.Optimize().Prefetch(ctx, opts)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
log.Println(res.Summary)
```

Samira: quick note — we renamed qprofile "shortseq" -> "shortseq-v2" in the last rollout. Add a one-line compatibility section: mapping table and fallback recommendation.

Elena K.: good catch, Samira. will add a short table and a fallback example using the runtime routing policy.

Tom: ran the smoke test on staging. small nits: the Python snippet needs an import for Client, and Go example is missing context.Context import. PR looks good otherwise. Link to my run: https://staging.redwood.dev/run/87312 (CI logs attached).

Rajeev: also suggest adding a tiny paragraph on when to prefer prefetch vs large-batching for low-latency streams (helps infra teams choose autoscaling knobs).

Elena K.: adding that now. also created the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827 — assigning @Tom and @Maya.
